description: IDDA Open Data Portal (Azerbaijan) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Innovation and Digital Development Agency (IDDA), Azerbaijan. The official state open data platform lists 888 datasets in 12 categories from 25 organisations, among them economics (246), education (64), transport (49) and health (36), and covers geography, environment and hydrometeorology; it runs on CKAN and Portal.js and has a data request form. Coverage: Azerbaijan. Formats and interfaces named: CSV, JSON. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the front page. Caveats: the CKAN interface sits on a separate host (api.opendata.az) whose TLS certificate has expired, so no dataset list could be read; only the counts on the front page are known. It can support finding transport, environment and hydrometeorology data of Azerbaijan. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
